The header's full-tier line also now lists kitprobes and release — it had gone stale on kitprobes when that stage landed. **2026-09-20, card t_4a81d75f:** a twelfth stage, `docs` (no kit counterpart), in CI_DEFAULT_STAGES and in .githooks/pre-push: docs/test-examples.py (all 66 examples, graded against $CI_BUILD_DIR/computo through COMPUTO_BINARY), docs/validate-coverage.py, and docs/LANGUAGE_REFERENCE.md plus both generated indexes held byte-for-byte to what docs/operators.yaml generates (generated into a temp dir, so the stage never rewrites a tracked file). python3 + PyYAML are prerequisites and a missing one FAILS the run instead of SKIPping — the clang stages' SKIP would leave a documentation stage that quietly does nothing, which is the seven-month hole this closes. Measured cause: git exports its TEMPORARY index to the pre-commit hook for `git commit -- <path>`, this repo's FetchContent update step in the `build` stage inherited it and ran `git status` inside build/_deps/jsom-src against Computo's index entries, and died on a blob that clone's object store does not have (`fatal: unable to read 691e2bdafaf312970644391de042d38c2c5972d8`, jsom-populate-gitupdate.cmake:186) — so a pathspec commit failed its own gate at `build` with a message about a dependency update, on a tree that builds fine.
